llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must wrap the form screen with `KeyboardProvider` and render form content in `KeyboardAwareScrollView` from `react-native-keyboard-controller`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: KeyboardAwareScrollView is used, but KeyboardProvider is never rendered anywhere in the submitted files.
evidence: App.tsx: no KeyboardProvider import or usage found

llmJudgeRequirements.reason: KeyboardAwareScrollView is rendered without a keyboardDismissMode prop; the prop is absent from the JSX.
keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled" is explicitly set on KeyboardAwareScrollView.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use `useReanimatedKeyboardAnimation` with Reanimated `useAnimatedStyle` to drive footer `translateY` from `-keyboard.height.value`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useKeyboardAnimation (not useReanimatedKeyboardAnimation) is used. The translateY expression also applies Math.max outside a worklet, which is not pure Reanimated. The required hook name is useReanimatedKeyboardAnimation from react-native-keyboard-controller.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use Reanimated `interpolate` over `keyboard.progress.value` to animate footer bottom padding during keyboard transitions.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No Reanimated interpolate call over keyboard.progress.value is present anywhere; footer padding is set as a static StyleSheet value, not animated.
evidence: App.tsx: no interpolate import or usage found
